# Float Left

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Float Left

Let's modify our previous code to make the box float to the left.

```html
1<div class="box"></div>
2<p class="content">This is some sample text.</p>
```

```css
1.box {
2    height: 200px;
3    width: 200px;
4    border-radius: 20px;
5    background: #ddd;
6
7    float: left;
8}
```

Output

![Float Left  Example](data:image/png;base64,)

With float: left, the box is positioned to the left, and the content wraps around it on the right. The content doesn't overlap but flows neatly beside the floated element.
